last_episode_to_air.overview: Competition between the wives continues beyond the grave as Essie and Joyce clash over how to memorialize Jonasi.

name: The Polygamist
overview: Social media darling, Joyce, is the picture of marital perfection — until her cheating husband's conquests ignite a scandalous emotional meltdown.
tagline: He chose betrayal, she chose revenge.

results.overview: Working-class, left-leaning Harry Perkins is elected PM. As he works to implement social change via democratic process, the conservatives and their allies quietly begin working to remove him. Perkins' goals include nuclear disarmament, the dissolution of newspaper monopolies, open government and the closure of all US military bases on UK soil. While many members of the govnerment oppose him, he finds some support in Home Secretary Joan Cook and key members of his staff.
results.name: A Very British Coup

results.overview: Polish immigrant Abel Rosnovski and Boston banker William Lowell Kane are two men born on the same day, and whose lifelong rivalry shapes their empires and families over decades. Their contrasting paths from poverty and wealth lead to a destructive, decades-long feud for power.
results.name: Kane & Abel

results.overview: A ghost was seen on the 12th floor of the Asakusa Juunikai building. A newspaper article featuring the sighting brought together Takuboku Ishikawa, who runs a private detective agency and his assistant Kyosuke Kindaichi to solve the case.
results.name: Woodpecker Detective's Office

results.overview: An Chu Xia and Han Qi Lu have a lot ups and downs in their relationship but end up getting engaged. A crisis hits the engaged couple on that day which later causes Qi Lu to lose his memory so he can’t remember his fiancée. What will Chu Xia do when her husband can't remember her?
results.name: The Demon Master

results.overview: In defiance to his superiors, a credit officer stands his ground in denying a grocery chain additional loans. Then the terrorist attacks begin.
results.name: Stock Price Crash

results.overview: After dying with her enemies, Ren Yaoqi is reborn five years in the past and seizes her second chance to change her fate. By carefully plotting to protect her family and relying on her own strength, she forms an equal partnership with Xiao Jingxi, and together they work to secure peace for the people and a future she once lost.
results.name: Reborn of The Rightful

results.original_name: 宝石商リチャード氏の謎鑑定
results.overview: One night, a college student with a strong sense of justice, Seigi Nakata, saved a gorgeous foreigner, Richard, who was being harassed by some drunks. When Seigi found out that Richard was a jeweler, he asked for an appraisal on a ring with a shady history; one which his grandmother had kept secret until she died. The appraisal had revealed her past, truth, and desire. It led Seigi to work as a part-time employee for Richard's jewelry store, the "Jewelry Etranger" in Ginza. While solving various "mysteries", the relationship between Richard and Seigi gradually changes.
results.name: The Case Files of Jeweler Richard

results.overview: A teacher starts her job at a high school but is haunted by a suspicious death that occurred there weeks before and begins fearing for her own life.
results.name: The Mess You Leave Behind

results.overview: After ten years of knowledge and choice, after the victory of the War of Resistance Against Japan, Lin Nansheng has grown into a true Communist Party member. And at the critical moment of the War of Liberation, he made outstanding contributions to the party and the country.
results.name: The Rebel

results.overview: High school senior Sheng Xia transfers to a new school, where a misunderstanding creates tension with classmate Zhang Shu. Despite their differences, their bond deepens over time as they grow through mutual support and shared challenges.
results.name: Summer in Your Name

results.overview: Director Sang Ru finds herself navigating a complicated relationship with Zhou Tingzhao when an unexpected twist takes her back to her university days. As past and present collide, their connection deepens, leading them on a journey of self-discovery, healing, and the courage to face life’s challenges together.
results.name: Touch Me Like You Lied

results.overview: After a fall swaps his soul into his grandson’s body, a 69-year-old man confronts college, queer romance, and the chaos of first love—all at once.
results.name: The Promise of the Soul

results.overview: Set in England in the early 19th century, Pride and Prejudice tells the story of Mr and Mrs Bennet's five unmarried daughters after the rich and eligible Mr Bingley and his status-conscious friend, Mr Darcy, have moved into their neighbourhood. While Bingley takes an immediate liking to the eldest Bennet daughter, Jane, Darcy has difficulty adapting to local society and repeatedly clashes with the second-eldest Bennet daughter, Elizabeth.
results.name: Pride and Prejudice

results.overview: An unconventional team of homicide detectives face various cases, as led by Tessa Vance and Steve Hayden. Hayden is an often light-hearted 'man's man' who is moving up the career hierarchy, while Vance is more introspective and no-nonsense, and often solves the murder with intuition and insight. Their team includes boss Inspector Malcolm Thorne, Constable Dee Suzeraine, forensic services expert Lance Fisk, and unorthodox doctor Imogen 'Tootsie' Soames.
results.name: Murder Call

results.overview: An exclusive group of privileged teens from a posh prep school on Manhattan's Upper East Side whose lives revolve around the blog of the all-knowing albeit ultra-secretive Gossip Girl.
results.name: Gossip Girl

results.overview: Seven noble families fight for control of the mythical land of Westeros. Friction between the houses leads to full-scale war. All while a very ancient evil awakens in the farthest north. Amidst the war, a neglected military order of misfits, the Night's Watch, is all that stands between the realms of men and icy horrors beyond.
results.name: Game of Thrones

results.overview: CIA officer Carrie Mathison is tops in her field despite being bipolar, which makes her volatile and unpredictable. With the help of her long-time mentor Saul Berenson, Carrie fearlessly risks everything, including her personal well-being and even sanity, at every turn.
results.name: Homeland

results.overview: An anthology horror drama series centering on different characters and locations, including a house with a murderous past, an asylum, a witch coven, a freak show, a hotel, a farmhouse in Roanoke, a cult, the apocalypse and a summer camp.
results.name: American Horror Story

results.overview: When a suburban man receives messages that seem to predict the future, he develops a following — and powerful enemies.
results.name: Kübra
